sources.title: kaban-baku/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S-384Exp-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 384Exp = 384 experts per layer, down from 512. The number of experts used per token (10) is unchanged. This is the IQ3_S file from ISTA-DASLab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF with 128 experts removed from every layer. The quantized expert weights and the router rows that are kept are copied byte for byte; nothing is re-quantized.
